Reviewed AddNext places existing node/sibling chain beneath transform, not ordinary sibling insertion; for entries1..29 then adds transform under root. Reviewed traversal skips instance children and can ascend outside starting car subtree. Resolves all four joints before attaching components, then calls owned helper for nonnull joints. Count narrows to s16 for helper and descriptor byte offset(s16)count*0x34; no range checks. No timer, recurring callback, idempotence guard or safe partial-construction recovery.
facts.rationale: Record fixed bound, signed narrowing, partial failures and exact shared hierarchy operations.

Constructor fixed30 entries reuses first child and reads data[1..29]; count is narrowed resource selector, not count. Animation calls require both anims and matanims; shape pointerNULL, frame0 mask0x497, rate callback1.0 mask0x76a4. Attachment geometry, race/hazard gameplay and physical data sections remain unverified.
facts.rationale: Separate canonical structure from gameplay, compiler layout and unreviewed callee effects.
